summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2116723960260026793))** explains *A-RSI* by Liu et al. ([arXiv 2610.38568](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.38568)): a VLM writes programmatic task generators for self-improvement and refreshes the task pool when reward variance or accuracy signals staleness, raising Qwen3-VL-8B's 11-benchmark average from 57.77 to 61.05 with 800 tasks.

referenced_urls.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
